content.comment_body: Good evening everyone, I'm currently working with a [article_no] base module that comes with 4 analog inputs (0-10V). Can these inputs be used for PT100/PT1000 sensors, or is a separate module required? I'm looking at the [article_no] module for reference. In the past, I had to purchase separate units specifically for temperature control. The voltage I'm using for the base module is 24V DC. Is there any official resource listing all compatible modules for the various base modules? Thank you for any advice, it's always helpful. Regards

The 0-10V analog inputs on the [product_name] base module can't directly read PT100 or PT1000 sensors. For this purpose, you would need an analog expansion module like the [product_name] (article number: [article_no]), or you would need to use external PT100/PT1000 converters that output signals in the range of 0-10V or 0/4-20 mA.

Hello, just a note for future reference: The [article_no] base module actually does not have built-in analog inputs. If you're using this specific base module, you'll need an [product_name] expansion module for analog inputs and outputs. Hope this clarifies things.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are trying to determine the compatibility requirements for connecting PT100/PT1000 temperature sensors to specific [product_name] modules. Users are unsure if base modules offer direct analog input support for these sensors, with clarification that an appropriate analog expansion module or an external converter is needed. There is also an expressed need for an official resource that details compatible modules for different hardware setups.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to know if it is possible to directly connect PT100/PT1000 sensors to the analog inputs of their [product_name] base module, or which additional modules are required. They also expect a clear and accessible guide that outlines module compatibility for [product_name] systems.
